csv_project_name: Engineering Services for Duncan Clinch Marina
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Traverse City is soliciting proposals from qualified firms for professional engineering and design services for the optimization of Duncan Clinch Marina, located at 111 E Grandview Pkwy, Traverse City MI as outlined in Attachment B. The goal is to reimagine the marina s layout, infrastructure, and operational systems to maximize usable space, improve efficiency, enhance functionality, and support long-term sustainability. This RFP invites proposals that include engineering and structural assessment, layout redesign, and strategic recommendations for improvements to marina operations, circulation, vessel accommodation, shoreline utilization, utilities, break walls, and support facilities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Cost Estimating, Site Evaluation/Selection, Land Use Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Energy Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies
